meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Maximum useful competitive-exam coverage. Includes definitions, classifications, numerical facts, rankings, locations, comparative geography, statement analysis, map-oriented relationships, textbook-supported cause/effect and evaluation. Excludes low-value classroom props, activity materials, arbitrary picture-identification and step-by-step ICT trivia.
source_notes: This file is stored as term-1/unit-6.json to avoid collision with History Units 1–4 and Geography Unit 1; display_unit=2 keeps the learner-facing Geography unit number correct.
Both English and Tamil 2025 books were used. Geography Unit 2 uses printed pages 176–189.

Activity content was converted only when it contains a competitive-exam fact (for example continent size order or map relationship). Questions about carrot slices, chart materials, clicking buttons, or classroom instructions were excluded.
Open atlas prompts were not answered from outside knowledge unless the answer is independently supported by the chapter text.
The chapter’s numerical values and terminology are preserved as printed, including ocean areas/depths and Mount Everest height.
